bootstrap.multiplicity: descriptive unadjusted intervals; no confirmatory significance claim

dependence: Repeated seeds, molecules, routes and cached pairs are not independent samples; report distinct identities/keys and occurrence denominators
design: Post hoc supplementary comparison; not preregistered; original 630 remain separate
failures: Keep every planned attempted outcome, including timeout, invalid, no_candidates and infrastructure interruption; terminal failures accept zero partial candidates; no retry/backfill
gate: All 270 unique planned slots, completed common scoring, response/source hashes and candidate occurrence joins verified before comparative estimates
hierarchy: Within each split: seed mean per query, query mean per target, equal target macro; paired method differences at identical query/seed slots before aggregation
infrastructure: Primary realized accepted return is zero; separately show bounded [0,1] missing-counterfactual sensitivity, not CI, and paired complete-case sensitivity excluding infrastructure only
limits: No activity, synthesis yield/probability or journal-readiness claim
Shared host is not a controlled hardware speed benchmark
missing_scores: Failed/unassessed 3D or route evidence is coverage loss, never a fabricated similarity zero or chemical synthesis failure; conditional means retain observed counts
primary: Engineering delivery endpoint: attempt_with_hop = int(evaluation.metrics.hop_families > 0). This measures delivery of at least one structurally changed output, not biological or synthetic utility

reuse.note: Preparation implements no scientific metrics; final paired analysis adapter still requires independent assessment

route_policy: No route supplied is unassessed; a CReM graph-edit reaction is not a synthetic route. Forward support uses the same predictor as pipeline selection, with selection bias; not independent experimental validation
secondary: exact known active and known inactive family recovery
common 3D success coverage and conditional shape/pharmacophore/joint scores
native work counts and measured resources

candidate_annotations.core_retaining_scaffold_expansion: Candidate satisfies existing hop definition, contains the query normalized Murcko scaffold as subgraph, and candidate scaffold has more heavy atoms than query scaffold. Descriptive graph expansion, not a proven reaction relationship.
candidate_annotations.query_generic_ring_skeleton_subgraph_ret: Same substructure direction using declared generic ring skeletons; useChirality=False; null if unavailable. This separately records topology retention regardless of elements/bond orders.
candidate_annotations.query_scaffold_not_contained: Candidate satisfies existing hop definition and atom/bond-aware query scaffold is not a subgraph. This does not prove pharmacophore preservation or a universally accepted scaffold-hop class.
candidate_annotations.query_scaffold_subgraph_retained: Candidate normalized Murcko scaffold HasSubstructMatch(query normalized Murcko scaffold), useChirality=False; null if either has no valid ring scaffold. Exact atom/bond-aware graph match, not MCS or 3D alignment.

secondary_scaffold_retention.failure_policy: Absent/non-normalizable scaffold gives explicit unassessed/null coverage; no invented false. All 270 slots remain in attempt-level denominators.
secondary_scaffold_retention.identity: Common versioned normalized Murcko scaffold family and generic ring skeleton from tested RDKit2025.09.6 policy
secondary_scaffold_retention.interpretation: Murcko scaffold difference, input-core retention, generic topology retention and measured activity/synthesis are distinct concepts. Do not use strict core replacement or true hopping as categorical biological claims.
secondary_scaffold_retention.reason: Independent fixed-example diagnostic found three different-Murcko outputs that all retain the input normalized Murcko core as a subgraph. Report this structural distinction explicitly instead of treating all scaffold differences as core replacement.
secondary_scaffold_retention.reporting: Within each split/method: occurrence counts, unique family counts, assessable coverage, and all-attempt indicator for at least one qualifying output. Same seed/query/target macro and paired intervals as existing plan; no endpoint selection based on future results.
secondary_scaffold_retention.subgraph_direction: query within candidate; asymmetrical. Report candidate/query scaffold atom counts. Fused-ring or bond/heteroatom changes must be classified from actual graphs, never string containment.
secondary_scaffold_retention.timing: Specified after this one nonbenchmark diagnostic, before any new270 comparative output; post hoc supplementary design, not preregistration

similarity.aggregation: Attempt mean of valid candidate occurrence similarities, then seed/query/target hierarchy; no-output/failed-score attempts are null for conditional means and remain in coverage denominators
similarity.common_3d: Fixed common CONFORMERS and seeds 42/43/44 in common-3d-plan.json; ligand-only exact canonical query/product inputs; all-seed success required, median over seeds for hit_shape/hit_pharmacophore/score and score_stability summaries
similarity.paired_missing: For conditional score contrasts, pair only identical query/seed slots with observed scores for both methods; report excluded slot/query/target counts. Bounded output indicators retain every planned slot
similarity.score_scope: The common 3D score retains the pinned conformer energy/strain term; it is not a calibrated probability or pure shape score

structural_definitions.active_scaffold_precision_proxy: Number of unique returned hop families whose scaffold matches an active reference / hop_families; zero if no hops
structural_definitions.active_scaffold_recall_proxy: recovered_active_scaffolds / reference_active_scaffolds; null when reference set is empty. No Tanimoto >= 0.5 gate or other similarity threshold is applied
structural_definitions.deduplication: First accepted valid occurrence per chemical family, preserving returned rank; invalid/duplicate raw-output accounting is retained separately
structural_definitions.exact_known_active_matches: Unique returned families represented by first-ranked valid output whose exact canonical isomeric SMILES matches an active same-target test record
structural_definitions.hop: Candidate has a ring scaffold, differs from input chemical family, and differs from normalized Murcko scaffold family; generic ring-skeleton change is separately counted
structural_definitions.identity: Common RDKit 2025.09.6 protonation-tautomer-family-v1 policy; family ignores stereo/isotopes, exact canonical isomeric identity retains them
structural_definitions.interpretation: Scaffold/family recovery is a retrospective structural proxy, not measured or predicted activity of new products; earlier control prefilter recall at T >= 0.5 is a different endpoint
structural_definitions.known_inactive_family_matches: Unique returned families present in inactive same-target test records; this is family-level, not exact inactive identity
structural_definitions.recovered_active_scaffolds: Distinct returned hop scaffold families intersecting reference_active_scaffolds
structural_definitions.reference_active_scaffolds: Unique normalized active scaffold families among same-target test partition, excluding input family and input scaffold and requiring a ring scaffold
